summary: Frontend-only verification of the three WEB-only features added this session: (1) Dex Sort Toggle on Original roster, (2) Frame Animation Pass, (3) Battle Entry Flourish; plus the requested regressions on Pokemon roster and Original detail sheet. All 5 scenarios pass with 0 page errors and 0 console errors across the whole run. (A) dex-sort-toggle is visible ONLY on the Original roster (hidden on Pokemon — confirmed on fresh load and after switching). Variety mode is active by default; data-active toggles correctly between dex-sort-variety and dex-sort-numeric. (B) Variety mode: pos0=#001 Mossplod WATER, pos1=#002 Mosshull, pos2=#003 Bathyward WATER/STEEL, pos3=#004 Jabibb NORMAL. Numeric mode: pos0=#001 Mossplod, pos3=#004 Cindcub FIRE; first 10 labels are strictly ascending #001..#010. The leading '#' on cards matches the active order. (C) Persistence: set numeric -> full page reload -> toggle still reads numeric active=true, pos0=#001 Mossplod, pos3=#004 Cindcub. Switching back to variety restores pos3=#004 Jabibb. (D) Battle flow: built a team of 6 unlocked ORIGINAL creatures (10001, 10090, 10110, 10019, 10102, 10076), went to tab-arena, selected terrain-card-shoreline, pressed start-battle-button (not disabled), landed on /battle, canvas rendered, triggered 4x speed, and the battle ran to completion with a full result sheet: 'Win · 112.0s · YOU 3/6 · RIVAL 0/6 · SEED 747231861' including per-creature species credits (Mossplod +3, Splashru +4, Orbling +3, Budox +1, Gaslug +1, Mothlet +1), YOUR TEAM HP/KOs/Dmg summary, RIVAL — SPECIALIST summary (all 6 opponents fainted), and REMATCH/SHARE REPLAY/ROSTER/SAVE REPLAY buttons. Switch-ins (auto-pick after Mossplod fainted) and the send-out entrance flourishes played without a single pageerror or console error. (E) Pokemon regression: dex-sort-toggle hidden; type-filter-fire -> 25 cards; adding gen-filter-1 -> 12 cards; clear-filters-button resets; search 'char' matches Charmander, Charmeleon, Charizard, Chimchar; creature-info-4 opens creature-detail-popover showing '#004 GEN I Charmander Lizard Pokemon FIRE 0.6 M · 8.5 KG · BST 309' with ability Blaze and stats. (F) Original creature detail regression: creature-info-10001 opens the sheet showing #001 Mossplod WATER BST 319, matchup-weak2/resist2/neutral/stab/moves panels, 3 evo-node-* entries, full BASE STATS (HP 51 / ATK 25 / DEF 44 / SP.A 82 / SP.D 53 / SPE 64). Dex number in the detail sheet DOES reflect the active sort mode: Jabibb (id 10068) renders as '#004' in variety mode and '#068' in numeric mode — matching the card label and the lib/format.js displayNo(creature, dexSort) contract. No React red screen, no uncaught exceptions, no ObjectId-like serialization issues (offline app, no backend calls).
critical_code_review_comments: lib/format.js displayNo(creature, mode) is the single source of truth for the Original roster '#' label: variety -> displayOrder ?? dexNo ?? id, numeric -> dexNo ?? id. Both CreatureCard (via `numberMode={dexSort}`) and CreatureDetailSheet (via `displayNo(creature, dexSort)`) consume it, so the card and the detail sheet stay in sync — verified live with Jabibb (#004 variety / #068 numeric).

GameContext.setDexSort is strict: `mode === 'numeric' ? 'numeric' : 'variety'` — any non-'numeric' value is coerced to 'variety'. save.js readSave applies the same guard, so a malformed localStorage never puts the toggle into a third state. Good.

GameContext.list memo sorts on `save.dexSort` directly from the save (no intermediate state), so the sort order flips instantly on click and is identical after a reload — which matches the observed persistence behavior.

RosterPage line 95 gates the toggle with `rosterId === 'original'`, so Pokemon can never see it even if save.dexSort is somehow 'numeric' — confirmed live (hidden on Pokemon after a reload while dexSort was still 'numeric').

RosterPage numeric search filter accepts BOTH `displayOrder` and `dexNo`, so searching '4' in variety mode still finds Jabibb and in numeric mode still finds Cindcub — preserved from iteration_13 and still working.

Battle reached a real end state (REMATCH button, species credit sheet, 'Win 112.0s YOU 3/6 RIVAL 0/6' header) at 4x speed in ~28s wall time. The 1x/2x/4x speed selector is exposed as plain `1x`/`2x`/`4x` buttons without data-testids — a dedicated testid like `battle-speed-4x` would make future automation less brittle (query by innerText works but is fragile). Not a blocker.

The 'Choose who goes next' switch sheet also lacks a stable testid on its 'AUTO PICK' button — same observation; we clicked it via /auto\s*pick/i regex over all buttons. Consider testid `battle-auto-pick`.

No console warnings or errors were emitted during battle (idle frame animation, entrance flourish, switch-ins, scaleguard, tidecaller, send-out). The reducedMotion gate on the entrance flourish was not exercised — environment reports prefers-reduced-motion=no-preference by default in Playwright.

Minor: RosterPage SortToggle visually sits to the right of the 'Order' label but on very narrow viewports it wraps below the filters — not tested here (desktop 1280 only), flagging as a thing to eyeball on mobile viewport.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dex sort toggle lives at data-testid 'dex-sort-toggle' with buttons 'dex-sort-variety' and 'dex-sort-numeric'; both expose data-active='true|false'. Toggle only renders on Original roster (check `[data-testid=dex-sort-toggle]` visibility to detect current roster post-reload — rosterId IS persisted in save). Verified Jabibb mapping: id 10068 -> displayOrder=4 (variety '#004') / dexNo=68 (numeric '#068'). For the battle flow, important testids: roster-toggle-original, creature-card-{id} with data-locked and data-selected, team-tray-count ('Team N/6'), tab-arena, terrain-card-{pitch|shoreline|cavern|snowfield}, start-battle-button. In the /battle screen the speed buttons (1x/2x/4x) and AUTO PICK button have NO testids — select by innerText. End-of-battle detection: look for a button whose innerText matches /^(rematch|back to arena|return to arena|continue|claim|new battle|next)/i. Long-press tap pattern (mouse.down 80ms + 250ms settle) still the most reliable way to add a creature to the team. A 6v6 at 4x speed completes in ~25-35s wall time; at 1x it exceeds 180s.
